thread:
kevin: Heads-up — Raven Corp private VPC deploy window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'm the primary deployer. Plan below, ping if you need changes.

olivia: ack. which cluster are we touching?

kevin: raven-prod-vpc-3 (us-west-2). touching model-serving nodes + load balancer config.

maria: do we have maintenance ACLs/just-in-time access for Raven infra team?

kevin: yes — Raven will be on a temporary peering rule and we gave them JIT via our access portal. They only have deploy role for the window.

jon: smoke checklist? who will run the smoke tests and where are results posted?

kevin: I will run primary smoke tests. Maria will validate external connectivity and Raven will run a quick ingest test. Post results to this thread. Quick smoke commands:
```
# healthcheck from control plane
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://raven-prod-vpc-3.internal/healthz
# simple inference check
curl -sS -X POST https://raven-prod-vpc-3.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

maria: noted. I'll run connectivity and cert checks at +15m after deploy.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: raven-prod-vpc-3 | start 1772508000 | end 1772515200 | owner kevin. (automated) :gear:

jon: rollback plan? quick steps?

kevin: rollback plan in case of major issue: 1) revert LB rule -> previous variant (1 command in console), 2) scale down new model-serving pods to 0, 3) flip back to canary model image tag. If we need DB rollback, stop traffic and restore snapshot (Raven agreed to snapshot during window). I exported the exact CLI commands to the infra runbook.

maria: can you paste the LB revert command here? ops teammate might not open runbook during the window.

kevin: LB revert: `redwoodctl lb update --name raven-edge --backend old-backend --force`
Also model revert: `kubectl set image deployment/raven-serving raven-container=registry.redwood/models:raven-v1.3.2`

infra-oncall: oncall here — I'll watch alerts during the window and will escalate if latency SLOs breach. Please @me in this thread at the start of rollback.

olivia: I'll be available for console ops + can run the `describe` checks if something weird shows up.

kevin: timeline recap: 02:00 start, 02:10 deploy model images to staging nodes, 02:25 LB switch to canary (5%), 02:35 run smoke tests, 03:00 ramp to 50%, 03:30 full flip if green by 03:20. Rollback window until 04:00.

jon: sounds good. small nit — add a 02:20 quick wait for cache warms before smoke tests? seen flakiness without it.

kevin: great catch. adding 5m warm-up after canary. updated timeline.

maria: thanks — i'll post checks here after I run them.

kevin: final ask: if you are on-call/ops please react with :white_check_mark: or say N+1 if you cannot cover.

olivia: :white_check_mark:

maria: :white_check_mark:

jon: N+1 (out of office but monitoring slack, can jump in if needed)

infra-oncall: :white_check_mark: — I'll monitor alerts and CPU/latency dashboards.

kevin: thanks all. will post a start message 5m before and then step updates.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window starts in 5 minutes for raven-prod-vpc-3 (1772508000).
